verdict.rationale: The only keyboard-related vendor evidence is a ROADMAP entry for 'Customizable keyboard shortcuts', which is a planned feature, not a shipped capability. Community users report that Zero 'does not yet have real keyboard navigation', and nothing in the pack documents a command palette. A single speed note about Durable Object/R2 storage does not cover the keyboard-first core of the story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait
